clips.title: The story
paras: In Brill, Deathguard Burgess keeps watch over the town for the Forsaken. He guards the settlement and points travelers toward the services they need.

North of the Undercity, Deathguard Burgess guards Brill against the Scourge and Scarlet Crusade. Like other Deathguards in Tirisfal Glades, he guides arriving Forsaken to local tradesfolk, class trainers, and civic services, helping keep the vulnerable outpost running.
